title: view, reshape or contiguous?
summary: What happens when you view a transposed tensor.

choices.text: Returns the 24 elements of `y` in row-major order of `y`, as a view sharing memory with `x`.
Raises an error, because `y` is not contiguous and `view` never copies; `y.reshape(24)` would copy.
Returns the 24 elements in `x`'s memory order, so the result equals `x.view(24)`.
Silently makes `y` contiguous in place first, then returns a view of it.
